content.text: The visible suite now passes (3/3). The cause was in `solution/util.py`: `_parse_field` hard-coded its "restricted" flag to `False`, so `core.py`'s `day_ok` never filtered by day-of-month or day-of-week, and `0 0 * * 0` matched Jan 2 (a Friday) instead of Sunday Jan 4. I changed the return to `restricted = not field.startswith("*")`, which is the standard cron rule. I left `core.py` alone. One thing to be aware of: when both day fields are restricted, `core.py` requires both to match (AND), whereas POSIX cron uses OR. That behaviour predates this bug and no visible test covers it, so I did not change it; if the hidden suite expects POSIX semantics, that line in `day_ok` is where to change it. Nothing under `tests/` was touched, and the public API is unchanged.
